content.text: Bedtime fights are really common at 19 months. One thing to try tonight is a short, boring routine in the same order every night. Bath, pajamas, two books, lights out, and the last step is always the same phrase. Keep the lights low and skip screens for the hour before. Toddlers push back less when they can predict what comes next. Then say goodnight and leave, even if they protest. Lingering usually stretches the whole thing out.
